parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The date and time when the SSH login attempt occurred.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The username provided during the SSH access attempt.

parameters.name: IPAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the client that attempted to access the SSH server.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number of the client that attempted to access the SSH server.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Represents the outcome or status of the SSH access attempt or session. The parameter indicates whether the attempt was successful or encountered an error.

object.description: This table logs each SSH login attempt made on the device. When the number of entries reaches the maximum specified by {{param|#.MaxAccessLogEntries}}, the oldest entry (determined by {{param|TimeStamp}}) will be deleted and a new entry will be created for the newest login attempt.
